verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents PostHog's product analytics (trends, funnels, retention) and feature flags, and mentions rolling out flags 'by person property, cohort, or group' (posthog-docs-6), but nowhere does it show that funnels/retention/trends insights can be run or grouped at an account/company level rather than per individual user. No mention of 'Group Analytics', account-level cohorts, or B2B company aggregation appears in any doc excerpt.
